outcomes.original: Filing step: If Planning confirms Conditional Use is required, file a Conditional Use Authorization application with San Francisco Planning, including a project description, site plan showing the outdoor area, and a statement of compliance with Mission SUD § 249.60(d) design requirements. What to say: Frame the outdoor seating as an accessory expansion of the existing restaurant use on the same parcel, with alcohol service subordinate to meals consistent with the Bona Fide Eating Place requirement. Commit to operating hours ending by 10 p.m. (or the time confirmed with Planning), seated service only with no standing, and alcohol dispensed inside or by wait staff at patrons' outdoor seats. Address good-neighbor policies: sidewalk maintenance within one block, noise and odor controls, indoor garbage containment, and a designated community liaison. Provide outside lighting, limit window signage to 33%, and maintain 50% clear glazing per § 249.60(d).
outcomes.note: The records reference § 249.60 but do not provide its specific requirements; the cited application is at a different address with no conditions shown.

outcomes.original: Filing step: Apply for a health permit to operate with the expanded outdoor seating area from San Francisco Department of Public Health, Environmental Health Branch. What to say: Submit the application online with the Business Account Number (BAN), Location ID (LIN), and federal tax ID. Confirm that a certified food safety manager is on staff (required before the permit is issued). Schedule a pre-opening inspection at least two weeks in advance once the outdoor area is ready. The outdoor seating is an expansion of the existing restaurant use approved in December 2019.
